wave._why: Wave 1 keeps the pinned four conscripts and two slingers. Spawn timing stays pinned.

pressure._why: Soldiers and the Fire mage keep their pinned damage and cadence.

power._why: Mana regen 1.25 so the second plant can be paid. Bolt and line stay pinned.

defence._why: The dome lasts 14 s, drains 1.5/s, and blocks 0.9 of a physical hit, so a 10-damage spear becomes 1 while it is planted. It blocks 0.92 of a magic hit. One-hand power is 1.0. The fire wall lasts 12 s, costs 6 mana, and covers 150 degrees so a blink does not step outside it.
